Replays credential audit records that a committed vault mutation still owes to the audit log (PRD-002: credential/audit commit ambiguity). The vault also replays lazily on its next mutation; this start-up pass closes the window for hosts that never mutate credentials again. Replay failure is logged and never refuses startup: the journal remains the durable marker.
